items.html: But it does not truly descend there; rather, it remains above as surrounding light for the whole of ZA. And you already know that every surrounding light is Ehyeh of Yudin, therefore Tzelem [image] equals Ehyeh in gematria, as above. It is thus found that this image contains the entirety of all the lower phases, which is the “Tzal” [shadow] within “Tzelem” [image], as will be explained, with God's help.
